children: Gerald J. Cardinale, Director, purchased 15,720 shares of Skydance Class B common stock directly on Nov. 19, 2026, at a weighted average price of $6.366 per share, and 95,100 shares directly on Nov. 20, 2026, at a weighted average price of $6.3221 per share, for a total purchase amount of $701,305. Following the transactions, Cardinale directly owned 335,720 shares and indirectly owned 438,182,884 shares: 175,000,000 through RB Tentpole LP, 38,479,440 through By RB Tentpole Holdngs LP, 158,333,333 through RB Tentpole Holdings II LP, 45,161,552 through RB Tentpole Holdings III LP, and 21,208,559 through By RB Maverick LLC. These entities are indirectly controlled by RedBird Capital Partners L.P.; as the sole member of RedBird’s general partner, Cardinale may be deemed a beneficial owner of their shares, but disclaims beneficial ownership except to the extent of his pecuniary interest.
